name: Warm Keynote
description: Warm cream paper with a faint 48px grid, dark brown text, teal as the only accent and orange-red reserved for consequences and risks. White glass cards (32px radius, large soft shadows), pill-shaped process nodes, section heads with a short teal bar and monospace text, Inter 900 big numbers, tables inside glass containers. Headings and body are Noto Sans TC (a local font), Latin and numerals use Inter, furniture uses JetBrains Mono. The style comes from a friend’s internal deck (with their consent, no attribution required); none of its content is used.

paper.use: page background (warm cream paper), the grid sits on top

ink.use: headings and primary text (dark brown); background of inverted pages

accent.use: the only accent: bars, short rules, keywords, nodes, charts, progress

surface.use: glass card background (laid over the paper at 85% opacity)

line.use: thin rules, table rules, pill borders, tabs

ink2.use: subtitles and body text (ink one step lighter)

accent2.use: teal one step darker: keywords, section labels, icons, big numbers

accentsoft.use: pale teal tint: tags, quote boxes, node glow (the original’s 10% teal, pre-blended)

alert.use: orange-red: text and circular arrows for consequences, risks and warnings

alertsoft.use: pale orange-red tint: consequence cards (the original’s 10% orange-red, pre-blended)

shell.use: text on inverted pages; the stage frame colour

surface3.use: sunk cards, table headers, code background, chart tracks

display.family: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif

body.family: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif

vocabulary: white glass cards with soft shadows
section heads with a short teal bar
